prompt: This time tomorrow, our flight ___ (cross) the Atlantic.
explanation: this time tomorrow sitúa la acción en curso en un momento futuro concreto.

prompt: At half past three tomorrow, the team ___ (present) its new website in a meeting that runs from three to four.
explanation: A las tres y media, la presentación estará desarrollándose.

prompt: At two tonight, while the website is being updated, it ___ (not / accept) payments.
explanation: La acción no estará en curso durante la actualización indicada.

prompt: ___ (you / use) the conference room at eleven tomorrow?
explanation: Future continuous permite preguntar de forma neutral por un plan esperado.

prompt: When we arrive home after midnight, the children ___ (sleep).
explanation: La acción estará en desarrollo cuando ocurra la llegada.

prompt: At noon tomorrow, the museum guides ___ (not / lead) tours; they will be attending a safety course instead.
explanation: At noon tomorrow exige describir lo que no estará ocurriendo a esa hora.

prompt: What ___ (you / do) this time next Saturday?
explanation: La pregunta pide la actividad en curso en un punto futuro.

prompt: The technicians will be checking the lifts at nine tomorrow morning.
solution: The technicians will not be checking the lifts at nine tomorrow morning.
explanation: La negativa añade not después de will y conserva be + verbo en -ing.

prompt: You will be using the recording studio at four tomorrow.
solution: Will you be using the recording studio at four tomorrow?
explanation: Will pasa delante del sujeto; be using no cambia.

prompt: At eight tomorrow evening, I will be attending an online seminar.
explanation: At eight tomorrow evening presenta la actividad en curso a esa hora.

prompt: The overnight train will be passing through Lyon around midnight.
explanation: Se describe un hecho esperado que estará en curso alrededor de medianoche.

prompt: Will you be driving to the office at eight tomorrow?
explanation: La pregunta neutral consulta qué actividad estará en curso a las ocho.

prompt: This time tomorrow, I ___ (fly) to Rome.
At eight tomorrow, she ___ (not / work).
___ you ___ (use) the kitchen at lunchtime?
They ___ (stay) at the hotel when we arrive.
We ___ (drive) all morning tomorrow.
At midnight, the musicians ___ (play).
He ___ (study) from nine to five tomorrow.
I will be attending the conference this time next week.
solution: I will not be attending the conference this time next week.
explanation: El auxiliar y la forma verbal muestran la estructura de este tiempo verbal.

prompt: They will be waiting when you arrive.
solution: Will they be waiting when you arrive?
explanation: El auxiliar y la forma verbal muestran la estructura de este tiempo verbal.

prompt: She will be travelling all morning tomorrow.
solution: She will not be travelling all morning tomorrow.
explanation: El auxiliar y la forma verbal muestran la estructura de este tiempo verbal.

prompt: At eight tomorrow evening, we will be having dinner.
explanation: El marcador temporal y el contexto indican Future Continuous.

prompt: When you arrive, I will be working.
explanation: El marcador temporal y el contexto indican Future Continuous.
